contrary_evidence: Higher Japanese yields do not demonstrate automatic repatriation; allocation remains conditional on hedging costs, mandates, liabilities, risk limits and expected returns.
Industrial subsidies do not establish commercial success; viability and diffusion remain open tests.

FY2023 energy indicators are structural reference points rather than current-month flows.

en.title: Japan: aging, monetary normalization and the external balance behind a global creditor economy
en.deck: Japan combines a shrinking workforce, monetary normalization, heavy energy-import dependence and a huge external asset position; together they explain why domestic policy changes can transmit into global rates, currencies and capital allocation.
en.regime: Aging and labor scarcity are colliding with monetary normalization while Japan remains a large external creditor and a highly energy-import-dependent industrial economy.
en.key_risk: Higher domestic rates and imported energy costs could raise fiscal and household pressure faster than productivity, real wages and labor-saving investment adapt.

pt-BR.title: Japão: envelhecimento, normalização monetária e o balanço externo por trás de uma economia credora global
pt-BR.deck: O Japão combina força de trabalho em redução, normalização monetária, forte dependência de energia importada e enorme posição de ativos externos; juntos, esses fatores explicam por que mudanças domésticas podem se transmitir para juros, moedas e alocação global de capital.
pt-BR.regime: Envelhecimento e escassez de trabalho se encontram com a normalização monetária enquanto o Japão permanece grande credor externo e economia industrial fortemente dependente de energia importada.
pt-BR.key_risk: Juros domésticos mais altos e custos de energia importada podem elevar a pressão fiscal e sobre as famílias mais rapidamente do que produtividade, salários reais e investimento poupador de trabalho consigam se adaptar.

selection_rationale.relevance: Japan recurs in recent Global Macro research through BOJ normalization, the yen, global bond transmission and energy-import exposure.
selection_rationale.context_gap: The public corpus lacks a country-level explanation connecting Japan's parliamentary policy structure, demography, external creditor position, industrial policy and energy dependence.
selection_rationale.reuse: Macro, wealth-flow, technology and energy research are likely to reuse these structural mechanisms.
selection_rationale.non_duplication: No existing Japan Strategic Transitions assessment or country dossier was found in the canonical corpus.
